verdicts.reason: A drops all of the original's pop-art geometry: the blue field, circles, stripes and triangles are gone, leaving a plain white page. It also puts the FIZZBANG! logo below the headline, which flips the original reading order, and leaves large dead gaps between the headline, logo and CTA. A cropped blue/teal strip sits jammed against the bottom edge and reads as an accident. B also loses all of the brand's background graphics, so it barely looks like the same design. However, it keeps the original order (logo, headline, CTA), and the headline is bold and dominant. Its weaker points are a cramped top margin above the logo and an empty, unbranded canvas.
